question: Seven people H, I, J, K, L, M and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between I and H when counted from the right of I. Only three people sit between M and L counted from the right of L. H sits to the immediate right of L. S sits to the immediate right of J. Who sits fourth to the right of K?
solution:
Seven people H, I, J, K, L, M and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

1.Only two people sit between I and H when counted from the right of I.

2. Only three people sit between M and L counted from the right of L.

3. H sits to the immediate right of L.

4. S sits to the immediate right of J.
